target_customer: Fortune and Global 500 companies, policy firms, non-profits and public affairs teams that monitor government publications
problem: Tracking legislation, regulation and government statements across many jurisdictions is slow, keyword based and limited to few sources.
business_model: Data and API subscription for regulatory and policy data; earlier products sold data from AI generated web scrapers
product_category: AI regulatory and public policy data

founders.name: Sandy Suh
founders.background_notes: YC page: machine learning researcher in program analysis and program synthesis. Education and employers were not on any page opened.

technical_complexity.rationale: Auto generating scrapers and data pipelines with program synthesis in 2021 was research flavored; later parsing policy documents from many countries needs multilingual NLP.

defensibility.rationale: A daily updated dataset across 64 to 70 countries is useful, but scraping and LLM extraction became widely available, and the company changed products several times.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found about incumbents copying or buying the company; it is still active in 2026.

market_need_then: The launch posts say existing policy tracking platforms are outdated and keyword based; no dated demand evidence for 2021 was found.

identity.visual_style: Minimal; the website returned only a title when fetched
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain launch posts addressed to developers and policy teams

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand; the name is easily confused with Paragon and Parsagon was one of several unrelated products described in directories.

pivots.from: AI generated web scrapers and data products such as real-time food price indexes, product data and browser automation (YC launch posts)
pivots.to: AI for public policy and government relations, then a universal regulatory data API
pivots.why: Not stated by the company; the sequence comes from eight YC launch posts, and exact dates are not shown

outcome_analysis: Parsagon remains active with a team of 2 and has launched at least eight products on YC Launch, moving from price indexes and scrapers to policy tracking and a regulatory data API. No funding, exit or traction figures are public. The repeated repositioning suggests a search for demand, but the sources do not say why.
notes: The company website returned only the title when fetched. No funding record was found under Parsagon; search results for Paragon, Statt, Page and Spaak describe other companies. Altss lists Family Office Investors but gives no amount or date, so no round is recorded. TheOrg (seen only in a search snippet, not opened) reportedly says Suh worked at Wayfair and co-founded Worldly; not recorded because the page was not opened. No competitor named in the launch posts and no dated rival source was found, so the list is empty. Founding year 2020 per the YC page; one directory says 2021. Launch posts are undated beyond relative ages.
